text:
anna: Quick Q — where do I find KV-cache hit/miss metrics for reserved GPU pools? I need a per-pool view to tune autoscale thresholds for eu-dedicated pools.

mike: There's a Grafana dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/RESERVED_POOLS . Use the dashboard variable $pool to select a pool. Look at panels 'Pool - KV cache (hit rate / size)' and 'Pool - Scaling events (scale_up/scale_down)'.

sean: PromQL I use for hit rate:
```
sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total{pool=~".+"}[5m])) by (pool) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total{pool=~".+"}[5m])) by (pool)
```
Cache size (bytes) per pool:
```
sum(kv_cache_size_bytes{pool=~".+"}) by (pool)
```
These are exported with labels: pool, customer_id, region.

tess: For traces use Tempo: https://tempo.redwood.ai . Filter by `pool.id` or service=runtime. E.g.:
https://tempo.redwood.ai/traces?service=runtime&pool=eu-dedicated-1
You can jump from a span to logs in Loki if you have the request_id.

mike: For alert tuning I'd recommend combining CPU and cache signals. Example pseudo-rule:
```
alert: PoolSaturationWarning
expr: (avg_over_time(instance_cpu_usage_percent{pool="$pool"}[2m]) > 80 and
       (1 - (sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total{pool="$pool"}[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total{pool="$pool"}[5m])))) > 0.15)
for: 3m
labels:
  severity: warning
annotations:
  summary: "Pool $pool showing high CPU and cache miss rate"
```
Also increase scale-down delay to 10m for dedicated pools to avoid flapping.

anna: Nice, that rule is exactly what I needed. One more: are these dashboards per-customer or shared? I need to know whether private deployments have separate views.

mike: Dashboards are shared but all metrics have `customer_id`. To view private deployments set the dashboard variable $customer_id or use a dashboard per-customer if you want stricter isolation. Let me know pool ids and I can add saved views.

infra-bot: Reminder: query-index-rotation runs daily at 03:00 UTC — metrics older than 30d may be archived. :information_source:

anna: Thanks all — I'll test queries and open a PR for alert changes if needed. :thumbsup:
